evidence: The most recognizable feature is the intricate hand-painted patterns on the traditional glaze background, a testament to the artisans' skill and dedication to their craft. Surrounding the shops are typically red brick courtyards, old kilns, small alleys, and bustling crowds of people visiting to look and shop.
